# Safe-zone guide on the vertical launch film

mgvideo safezone burns the Reels, Shorts and TikTok safe area onto the native 9:16 launch film (f07) for review: shaded top and bottom margins where the app UI sits, and the dashed area the cards must stay inside.

- Type: Safe-zone guide
- Skill: `magnifito-variants`
- Engine: `safezone`
- Output: 1080x1920, 15 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f20-safezone-guide.mp4`](../videos/f20-safezone-guide.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-variants skill to check the vertical launch film (../videos/f07-native-vertical.mp4) against the mobile safe zones before it goes to Reels and Shorts. Burn the safe-area guide over the whole clip so the client can see that every card stays clear of the top and bottom UI margins, and save the review copy as work/safezone.mp4.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f20-safezone-guide
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f20-safezone-guide/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo safezone ../videos/f07-native-vertical.mp4 --out work/safezone.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/safezone.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
